body:
Methoxetamine Nightmare
I am an experienced psychonaut who made it a mission to explore the realms that plants and chemicals take the mind too. I have experience with most of the old school psychedelics plus a number of research chemicals.
Of all the ones I have tried K stood out as King! So much that I formed a habit that could have cost me alot if it were not for the supply running out.
Fast forward 2 years of clean living (besides whiskey and weed) and I move to America the land of the somewhat free use of new research chemicals. Excited about MXE I purchase 5 grams online.
It arrives on a saturday and the owner of the house I am temperary staying with goes out for the night, so I painstakenly cuts it into 5 piles and then on the 5th pile makes 10 lines (very stupid I know but I didnt have scales).
7pm - Snort a (eyeballed) 100g line. Sit back and watch The Universe on history, as with K it tends to lead the thoughts into what Im watching. As time passes I feel a similarity to K, with the integration into what I am watching, drifting off in thought into things that seem to be secrets of life/universe by powerful forces yet I can never recall 99% of it.
I feel a similarity to K, with the integration into what I am watching, drifting off in thought into things that seem to be secrets of life/universe by powerful forces yet I can never recall 99% of it.
But MXE seemed to lack the feel good feeling that K has on me.
11pm - I feels some effects diminishing and decide that I can take this further as I used to bump with K to get to the right level/depth of the K-universe. I snort another 100g line and sit back. At some stage, not sure if it was long or short I think I am not deep enough, I need more, but I remembers the confusion at this intoxicated state and it was a quick battle in my head whether to do another line or not. The crazy side won and I hit a third line, next thing I remembers is coming to in a deep trip. I was part of some machine in a room that was very alien and seemed small. It had no meaning yet I was living this and it was very real!
I come out of this trip and I find myself lying on the ground, I look at my surroundings and can recall that I am at a friends house but am confused as to why there is bright sunlight coming through the windows. I look at the time but can make no sense of time. I convince myself that I had taking MXE during the day and sit on the couch and end up back into a trip as real as the previous one. This repeats a couple of times and each trip is a different story/movie, basically a dream world but I had control to move through this realm. Amazingly I can recall in detail 3 of these experiences and they were mind blowing but more like controlable dreams than say a journey into the K realms.
But one scared me and that was I felt like the world had ended because of something that I had the control to do but couldnt do in time (I had similar experiences from a strong K session), and like its 'game over' in an arcade and the music changes and a block froze over me but it wasnt cold it just froze my whole body with a slight tilt downwards like I was defining gravity. I shook out of this and decided its time to straighten up as the house owner could be home any minute. I got up and managed to stumble to the kitchen, its like a DXM robo walk, I get a drink of water and tried to eat but could not stomach anything. I repeat this cycle a number of times, like I am in a loop. The house is still transforming, ie stairs dissapear and house configuration looks completly different, and at some points I am totally lost as to what house I am in.
I decided a bath will straighten me out, and laying face down in the water and being still brought on great visuals and relaxed the mind. This relaxed period only lasted until I got out and I realized that I was not well. I tried to relax so I went to lay on my bed, but as I did my chest felt so heavy like bricks were on it. My breathing was extremely hard so I sat up immediately and it relieved it somewhat. I looked in the mirror and noticed a black eye and the eye itself is red (it was scratched) but in my horrified state I start to think I has seriously OD and the vessels in the face are ruptured. I looks at the plate I made the piles of MXE on and its broken in half with powder spread out. I look at the pile and it looks like alot has gone, at this stage I am not sure if I took more after that 3rd line as it looks alot less.
I decide I needs help at this stage but I cannot find my phone. I look all around the house for what feels like hours and at times I sit down and try to get a grip, but I feel that something is not right. Finally I finds it under the couch and call for an ambulance. I had extreme difficultly speaking, it was like I was a complete retard having to speak very slowly.
Sitting there waiting I hear the sirens and grab my important things like wallet and phone, lock the house and meet a fire truck and police car. Both surround me and start to question me, they laugh and ridicule me as I cannot talk properly, luckily an ambulance turns up and I look at him and say 'I need help' with a pleading for my life sound.
I end up in hospital at 6pm on Sunday and doctors are worried that my heart enzyme levels are spiking. They mention that heart attacks are usually around 9 while mine are 0.6 (I cant remember the exact number) but they say that any increase is a danger sign. Luckly every other organ seems fine. I sit there for about 24hrs hooked up to heart monitors while I get various tests done to me (heart scan was one) and nurses asking me if I have a will and family I would like to call, which only makes me go into a super depression as I didnt want to die. I get told that my heart might have permanent damage also which again sends me deeper into despair. I call the owner of the house who comes and visits me in the hospital and says he has my back. I cannot bring myself to ring my wife or family who were in another country. I release myself on tuesday and am still struggling to walk, I thins I may have permanent damage due to balance issues but am worried about the health costs not knowing if insurance would cover me or not. I manage to work from home on weds but my brain feels majorly fried, swollen and sore.
I have not been able to sleep since the night I took the MXE. I experience extreme nightmares about what I have created that keeps me up. Fearing losing a new job I pick up the courage to go to work on the thursday which was extremly hard as I was still getting flashbacks which basically made it hard to see and think. It was like I was getting tunnel vision and at one stage I almost fell over at work. It doesnt help that I have had no real sleep for days now.
I get asked to move out of the house for what I have done and move to a hotel room. It took a couple of weeks to feel myself again, and I am thankful beyond belief that it didnt affect my movement nor my mind permanently.
This had a very bad reaction.
Needless to say I will never go near this stuff again, and wouldnt recommend it to anyone, too dangerous!
